## Description

Apple and Google developer accounts under the company; privacy labels and data-safety forms matching the data map; MASVS L1 review plus root/jailbreak and screenshot rules; TestFlight and closed testing with a pilot clinic; accessibility (screen reader labels, 200 % text) and en/hi/ar checks; EAS Update limited to UI fixes while clinical logic ships with store builds and release notes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a build, when it is submitted, then privacy labels match the data map.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the MASVS review, when it finishes, then no open high or critical finding.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an OTA update, when it contains clinical logic, then the pipeline refuses it.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
